title: Aurora Rising
author: Alastair Reynolds
review:
I think reading Revelation Space before this is sort of required as it ties into that quite a bit.

Some of the mysteries weren't resolved in the most satisfying manner but I still really enjoyed the book overall. Was pretty engaged with the plot and there were plenty of dark moments, good sci-fi concepts, and it tied into Revelation Space really well.

Alastair does have some issues with endings to be honest but I'm hoping to see more developments in the successive books in the series. Clearly above a 3/5 and a really good book overall.
